name: Locust-Shade Breathing (Hòe Âm Thổ Nạp Công)
concept: Sat at noon in the shade of a living locust. The leaves cool the air and the breath, and the root learns to draw Water qi down through Wood the way a tree draws water up. Slow and steady; it builds linh lực sustain and Wood regrowth, and it is useless while the holder burns: a Fire stack on her stops the regrowth until it clears.
lore: Tiêu Chủng Hòe's, from the hunter's habit of resting under trees; written down in 700. The clan has never taught it outside the family.
notes: Tiêu clan water/wood patient-ward and wood-regrowth main method (Stage 6).

name: Twin Span Pillar Method (Song Kiều Trụ Pháp)
concept: A mason's method: the cultivator stands waist-deep in moving water and sinks their qi into the riverbed like a pillar, so the current breaks around them. It trains health, block and the body's weight more than art power.
lore: Ôn Giá Hồng's, from forty years of sinking pillars before the bridges of 900.
notes: Ôn clan earth/wood guard-bridge main method (Stage 6).

name: Returning Swallow Breath (Quy Yến Tức)
concept: The breath goes out and comes back as swallows leave and return: each cycle sends qi out to the limbs and draws it home with a little more. Its arts echo, striking once and again. The manual stops at the ninth layer, and the clan believes a second half stayed in the old hall.
lore: The one method the Tạ carried out of their old hall in 470 (A193); its script is older than anything in Phong Lâm.
notes: Tạ clan wood/water light courier main method (Stage 6).

name: Seed Store Method (Tàng Chủng Pháp)
concept: Qi is put away like seed grain over winter: gathered in the autumn sittings, sealed, and drawn on only when needed. Slow to build, nothing wasted; it gives health and linh lực pools and a late surge.
lore: Lục Đa Cốc's farmer's method, after the harvest of 600. Every Lục child learns it before letters.
notes: Lục clan pure wood reserve-and-recovery main method (Stage 6).

name: Reeling Thread Breath (Trừu Ti Tức)
concept: A breath drawn as fine and unbroken as a thread reeled from a cocoon in hot water: Fire heat, Earth patience. It builds long debuffs rather than hard hits. Sung, not read: the layers are verses of the Hỏa Ti reeling songs.
lore: Nhan Dư Ti's songs from Hỏa Ti (N-chuc_ha-01), written down by her grandson about 680.
notes: Đới clan fire/earth silk-needle curse method (Stage 6).
